title: Strictness vs. Inspiration in Education
grammar: Lexicalized vs. productive causatives (tanít vs. taníttat, épít vs. építtet)
goal: I can distinguish primary lexicalized causatives (tanít, épít, állít) from double/productive causatives (taníttat, építtet, állíttat)
I can explain who performs the action directly versus who finances, commissions, or arranges it
I can use B2 vocabulary of educational philosophy, sponsorship, and intellectual discipline
